copied.description: Confirmation shown on any copy button for a moment — the chip card, the triage panel and the first-run page share it.

extDescription.message: Shows how heavily each paragraph looks AI-edited. Scored on your own computer.

cmdNextFlagged.message: Go to the next flagged paragraph

cmdPrevFlagged.message: Go to the previous flagged paragraph

menuAnalyzeSelection.description: Right-click menu entry on a text selection.

menuAnalyzePage.description: Right-click menu entry on a page; runs once without writing a setting.

menuOpenPdf.description: Right-click menu entry on a link to a PDF.

bandUnsupported.description: No verdict: the model reads English only.

langUnknown.description: Detected-language value when no language code came back.

cardPending.description: Chip card while the batch is in flight.

cardScaleTitle.description: Tooltip on the big number in a card.

cardPartsTogether.description: Card row label: how many paragraphs this one verdict covers.

cardWindows.description: Card row label for a long text read in several passes. $1 = pass count (2+).

cardScored.description: Card row label: how much of the text reached the model.

cardFirstWords.description: Card row value paired with cardScored. $1 = word count.

cardOfCount.description: Card row value: a count out of a total.

cardFootUnsupported.description: Chip card footnote for a non-English paragraph.

coverageShort.description: A line of the chip card, the selection card, the copied report and the text analysis page, for a verdict on a text shorter than the model's training minimum. $1 = 75.

coverageOpeningParagraph.message: Only the opening of this paragraph was scored.
coverageOpeningParagraph.description: Card footnote sentence; the trailing space joins it to the next sentence.

coverageOpeningSelection.message: Only the opening of this selection was scored.
coverageOpeningSelection.description: Card footnote sentence; the trailing space joins it to the next sentence.

coverageTooDense.message: Part of it is too dense for one pass of the model and was not read.
coverageTooDense.description: Card footnote sentence; the trailing space joins it to the next sentence.

coverageOtherLanguages.message: Passes in another language were left out.
coverageOtherLanguages.description: Card footnote sentence; the trailing space joins it to the next sentence.

coverageAveraged.message: Longer than the model reads in one pass, so it was read in $1 passes, and each part is judged by the passes that read it.

selTooShort.description: Selection card verdict below the evidence floor.

selNeeded.description: Selection card row label: the evidence floor.

selFirst.description: Selection card row value when only the opening was read. $1 = word count.

selFootNoAnswer.message: The local engine did not answer — try again.

selFootUnavailable.message: The local engine did not answer — try again.
selFootUnavailable.description: Selection card footnote on a degraded verdict.

selFootUnsupported.description: Selection card footnote for non-English text.

panelRetry.description: Panel action beside the daemon-down notice.

panelCommentsElsewhere.message: Comments here come from $1, which Anagram may not read.

panelCommentsAllowAria.message: Allow Anagram to read comments from $1
panelCommentsAllowAria.description: Accessible name of that button. $1 = the host name.

panelTitle.description: Triage panel heading with nothing flagged.

panelTitleCount.description: Triage panel heading. $1 = flagged count, $2 = paragraphs read (given a verdict).

panelCopyReport.description: Panel action: copy the page's verdicts as text.

panelEmptySoFar.description: Panel title while the page's paragraphs are still being read and none of those read is flagged.

panelNotEnglishPage.message: This page isn't in English: Anagram reads English text only.
panelNotEnglishPage.description: Toolbar menu over a page none of whose paragraphs is in English: why nothing was scored.

panelCovShort.description: Coverage line: prose the walk found and did NOT score, under the minimum length (Settings) with no neighbour of its own voice to join.

panelCovNotEnglish.description: Coverage line: units the language gate refused. Shown only when there are any.

panelCovPending.description: Coverage line: units still waiting for the daemon. Shown only when there are any.

panelCovUnavailable.description: Coverage line: units the daemon never answered for. Shown only when there are any.

panelItemAria.description: Accessible name of a panel row: verdict, the score with its leading zero (a screen reader reads a bare ".93" badly), snippet.

actionCloseReading.description: Ball action chip while the Docs reading overlay is open.

actionBackToEditor.description: Ball action chip on the static Docs view.

actionAnalyzePdf.description: Ball action chip on a PDF tab.

reportCopyFailed.description: Report privacy preference, export metadata, or cache status shown in settings.

readerOpenOriginal.description: Reader button: leave for the PDF itself.

readerLoading.description: Reader notice while the file is fetched.

readerNoText.message: This PDF's pages are images, with no text to read.

readerTooLarge.message: This PDF is too large to read here.
readerTooLarge.description: Reader notice past the size cap.

readerBusy.message: Other PDFs are still being opened. Open the original and choose Anagram again in a moment.
readerBusy.description: Reader notice when PDFs other tabs are handing over hold all the memory the handoff may use.

readerBadFile.message: This file could not be read as a PDF.

readerFetchFailed.message: This PDF could not be loaded. Drop the file here instead.

readerReadWhole.description: Button in the toolbar menu over the PDF reader where, on a slow computer, only the pages around the one being read are read ahead.

onbUserGuide.description: Link to the online user guide.

engineTerminalWhat.description: Setup page, local engine card on macOS and Linux: what it is.

engineTerminalWhatWindows.description: Setup page, local engine card on Windows: what it is.

enginePaused.description: In-browser edition: engine status while the model download is paused.

engineSetupFailed.description: In-browser edition: engine status when the model download stopped on an error.

popupSetupStoppedStorage.message: There isn't enough disk space for the model
popupSetupStoppedStorage.description: Toolbar menu, in-browser engine: the model download stopped because the disk is full.

popupSetupStoppedServer.message: The model's download site isn't answering
popupSetupStoppedServer.description: Toolbar menu, in-browser engine: the model download stopped because the server failed.

popupSetupStoppedDamaged.message: A downloaded model file was damaged
popupSetupStoppedDamaged.description: Toolbar menu, in-browser engine: the model download stopped because a file failed its checksum.

engineLeftMinutes_other.description: In-browser edition: the download's estimated time left; $1 is minutes.

engineRetrying.description: In-browser edition: after the download progress, while a lost connection is retried by itself.

engineKeepDownloading.description: In-browser edition: the confirmation's button that leaves the download alone.

accessAllowAll.description: Button that requests access to every site.

accessWithdraw.description: Button that removes every site grant.

optCommentsFrom.message: The page you came from shows comments from $1. Anagram reads them only with access to that site.
optCommentsFrom.description: Settings, Site access: shown when the panel's Allow button opened Settings. $1 = the comment site's host name.

optCommentsAllow.description: Button that asks the browser for access to the comment site. $1 = its host name.

optCommentsAllowed.message: $1 is allowed. Its comments are read on the sites Anagram is on.
optCommentsAllowed.description: Settings, Site access: the comment site is granted. $1 = its host name.

optEnabled.message: Run on granted sites by default
optEnabled.description: Switch: analyze granted sites unless a rule says otherwise.

optColSite.description: Column header and field label for a hostname.

optColRule.description: Column header and field label for a rule.

optRemove.description: Button that removes a rule; also the hidden header of that column.

optNoRules.description: Empty state of the rules table.

optBadHost.description: Validation error of the add-rule form.

optAlreadyCovered.description: Note when a parent domain's rule already says the same; $1 is that host.

optCacheMode.description: Select label: where scores are kept.

optClearCache.description: Settings: button that clears the cached verdicts.

optCleared.description: Confirmation after the cache was cleared.

optSaveFailed.message: The change could not be saved.
optSaveFailed.description: Error when a setting could not be written.

listSeparator.description: Between the parts of a status line built in code, such as the popup's counts.

onbTagline.message: Marks AI-written paragraphs as you read. Everything runs on this computer.
onbTagline.description: Setup page: the one line under the name.

onbWhere.description: Setup page: heading of the permissions block, first on the page.

onbVerdictTitle.description: Setup page: heading of the block that explains the words, the colours and the dot.

onbScoreLine.message: Each paragraph gets a chip with a score from .00 (human) to 1.0 (AI-generated), in its word's colour. Hover the chip for the details. AI-generated paragraphs are flagged: the toolbar menu lists them, and the number on its icon counts them.
onbScoreLine.description: Setup page, under the four words and the coloured scale.

onbStepDone.description: Setup page: beside a step that is complete.

onbModelNotice.message: Anagram uses Pangram's open EditLens model (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). Commercial use is not permitted. It should not be used to enforce any AI-usage policy in an educational or professional setting.
onbModelNotice.description: Setup page: the licence and fair-use notice for the model, in the spirit of Pangram's own.

accessHint.message: or switch it on per site from the toolbar icon
accessHint.description: Setup page: beside Allow all sites.

accessAllowed.description: Setup page and Settings: all-sites access is granted.

optReadAhead.message: Read whole PDFs in the background
optReadAhead.description: Settings, PDFs: switch for reading the pages of a document before they are scrolled to.

optReadAheadNote.message: Paced to how fast this computer scores: a fast one reads the whole document, a slow one the pages around where you are, and only while you are not scrolling.
optReadAheadNote.description: Settings, PDFs: the note under the read-ahead switch.

optLocalPdfs.description: Row label: reading PDF files opened from this computer.

optFileAccessTurnOn.description: Button that takes the person to the browser's page where file access is switched on.

engineKeepOpen.message: Keep this browser open until the download finishes.
engineKeepOpen.description: Shown only while the in-browser engine's model downloads.

engineWordsBrowser.description: Settings engine row: where the engine runs, first words of its status.

engineWordsGpu.description: Settings engine row: the model runs on the GPU.

engineWordsCpu.description: Settings engine row: the model runs on the CPU.

optMinWordsHint.description: Settings: tiny hint under the minimum length.

safariEngineTitle.description: Safari: title of the in-browser engine card on the setup page.

safariEngineTabNote.message: Keep the Anagram engine tab open while analyzing pages. Safari runs the WebGPU engine in this pinned tab. Closing it interrupts analysis; the next request opens it again.
safariEngineTabNote.description: Safari: why a pinned extension tab stays open while the engine runs.

safariEnginePrivacy.message: Text is scored on this Mac. The model downloads once; page text is never sent to a server. Model memory is released when the engine is idle.
safariEnginePrivacy.description: Safari: the in-browser engine runs locally; nothing is uploaded.

safariEngineSetup.description: Safari: button that starts the in-browser engine setup.

safariEngineSettings.description: Safari: link from the engine card to Settings.

safariBrowserRequired.message: Anagram for Safari requires Safari 27 or later on a Mac, with WebAssembly JSPI and browser file storage available. Update Safari, then reopen setup.
safariBrowserRequired.description: Safari: shown when the Safari version is too old for the in-browser engine.

safariWebGpuRequired.message: The in-browser engine needs a hardware WebGPU adapter that can run the model. This Mac does not currently offer a compatible adapter. It cannot run this engine on the CPU.
safariWebGpuRequired.description: Safari: shown when WebGPU is unavailable, so the in-browser engine cannot run.

safariLocalPdfNote.message: Open the PDF reader and choose or drop a PDF from this Mac. Safari does not allow Anagram to read file:// tabs directly.
safariLocalPdfNote.description: Safari: local PDFs are opened with the reader's file picker, not by file access.

safariOpenPdf.description: Safari: button that opens the PDF reader's file picker.

toolbarPinTitle.description: Setup page and Settings: title of the step that keeps Anagram's icon in the browser toolbar.

toolbarPinHelp.message: How to keep Anagram in the toolbar
toolbarPinHelp.description: Toolbar menu: link to the pinning instructions, shown while Anagram is not pinned.

toolbarPinIntro.message: Everything Anagram does is in its toolbar menu: each page's results, the switch for each site, and Settings.
toolbarPinIntro.description: Setup page: why to pin Anagram — its toolbar menu is where it is used from.

toolbarExtensionsMenu.message: Click the Extensions button (puzzle piece) beside the address bar.
toolbarExtensionsMenu.description: Pinning step 1 (Chrome, Firefox): open the browser's Extensions menu.

toolbarChromePin.message: Find Anagram and click the pin beside it.
toolbarChromePin.description: Pinning step 2 in Chrome: click the pin beside Anagram.

toolbarFirefoxPin.message: Open the menu beside Anagram (gear or three dots), then choose Pin to Toolbar.
toolbarFirefoxPin.description: Pinning step 2 in Firefox: pin Anagram to the toolbar.

toolbarSafariEnable.message: In Safari → Settings → Extensions, make sure Anagram is enabled.
toolbarSafariEnable.description: Pinning step 1 in Safari: enable the extension.

toolbarSafariCustomize.message: Choose View → Customize Toolbar from the menu bar.
toolbarSafariCustomize.description: Pinning step 2 in Safari: open Customize Toolbar.

toolbarSafariDrag.message: Drag the Anagram icon beside the address field, then click Done. If it is already there, you are ready.
toolbarSafariDrag.description: Pinning step 3 in Safari: drag Anagram into the toolbar.

popupReportRange.description: Toolbar menu, flagged list paging: $1–$2 of $3 flagged paragraphs.

popupResultsPrevious.description: Toolbar menu, flagged list paging: previous page.

popupResultsNext.description: Toolbar menu, flagged list paging: next page.

popupPageActionFailed.message: The page changed or is no longer available. Reopen Anagram and try again.
popupPageActionFailed.description: Toolbar menu: the page did not carry out the requested action (jump, document action).
